description: One widget's views, completions, conversion, and its leads grouped by referrer. The referrer is whatever the visitor's browser reported when they submitted, so it is a rough attribution, not a tracked source. Also returns the funnel (views, completions, leads, conversions, revenue in cents; conversions are purchases credited to a lead within 14 days of capture), questionDropoff (how many visitors left a survey on each question, in question order) and the same optional from/to date range as read_analytics.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: read_widget_results
title: Read widget results
